conviction_note: H1 operating profit should land about on the 34.7bn plan: Q1 beat it, and Q2 (Jun-Aug) carries domestic sales of only +2.1% after Q1's gross margin had already slipped 0.9pt. The plan is likely held while consensus sits 3% above it, and the stock has run +4.4% in two sessions on September comps into a print type it has sold 9 times in 12. So p_up is 42 on an abs move of 5.5, giving -0.88. The findings sum to -1.3 because each is sized alone. The scaled number is smaller because most of the negative rests on public 月次 and on reaction history, not on a document the market lacks.
bar: Company H1 plan (第2四半期累計): sales 200,100m JPY, OP 34,700m, ordinary 35,670m, NP 24,640m, unchanged at Q1 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260708/140120260708589428.pdf). Q1 delivered OP 20,316m, so Q2 needs 14,384m vs 14,887m last year. Street FY ordinary consensus is 69,561m vs company 67,400m (kabuyoho consensus tracker, 2026-09-08, https://kabuyoho.jp/reportNews?bcode=2670). No H1 consensus figure was sourced, so the H1 bar is the company plan.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position at or above 0.5%), unchanged (as of 2026-09-29, baseline). 信用倍率 7.52x (kabutan, 2026-10-07): a crowded margin long, the one setup in which a visible miss still has sellers. No options, so no skew. priced_lean_pct -0.56, mostly margin_overhang. Run-up: 20d +2.4%, 5d +2.5%, with +4.4% in the last two sessions (2,666.5 on 10-02 to 2,794.5 spot) after the 10-05 September 月次.

findings.finding: Q2 (Jun-Aug) looks like a year-on-year operating-profit decline that leaves H1 at plan rather than above it. Domestic all-store sales were +2.1% in Q2 (June -6.6%, July +6.6%, August +6.5%) against +7.3% in Q1. Q1 consolidated gross margin had already fallen 0.9pt (single entity 1.1pt) while SG&A grew 4.8%. July and August growth was driven by the summer sale, Obon sales and promoted kids collabs, and it laps a Q2 last year whose gross margin rose 0.2pt on full-price hands-free shoes. Q1 ABC inventory was +10.3% YoY against sales +6.5%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 on 2026-07-08 posted record OP (+8.3%) and the stock fell 11.37% the next day. Press attributed it to gross margin falling more than the market expected from heavier promotion, plus Korean margin erosion (kabutan n202607090343; kabuyoho 7/9). Last year's H1 print (2025-10-08, OP -1.2%) fell 8.81%.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q2 sales line is public (rule 1) and partly priced: sell-side targets were cut in September (US house 3,500->3,300 on 9/4, European house 2,690->2,650 on 9/2, JPM 3,200->3,100 on 9/28; Nomura initiated Neutral at 2,800 on 9/30). The gross margin and inventory at Q2 end are not visible in any series. The stock trades at 2,794, above its post-Q1 level of 2,592, on the September comps rally. If the market expected another gross-margin step-down, the September rally would not have taken it back above most cut targets.
findings.independence: Q1 data sheet (gross margin, SG&A, inventory): https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260708/140120260708589438.pdf. Last year's H1 summary (Q2 gross margin +0.2pt on full-price sales): https://www.abc-mart.co.jp/ir/pdf/2026/kessan02_siryou.pdf. Analyst target cuts: https://kabuyoho.jp/reportNews?bcode=2670. Separate documents, one inference.

findings.finding: No 業績予想の修正 was filed before the print, and at Q1 the company said results were 'broadly as planned'. FY26 went the whole year without a revision, so the FY plan (OP 65.6bn, ordinary 67.4bn) is likely held while street ordinary consensus sits about 3.2% above it at 69.6bn, edging down weekly.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Kabutan's revision table shows FY2025 revised at the H1 print (24/10/09), and the next day was +0.10%. FY2026 had no revision at H1 (25/10/08), and the next day was -8.81%. FY2027's guide on 26/04/08, with a dividend increase, was +7.66% the next day.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus above plan means holders are relying on H2. A held plan with a Q2 decline leaves that gap open. If the market had priced a hold, consensus would have converged to plan, and it has only drifted 0.1-0.2% a week. A raise on the strength of September's +14.9% is the upside case, which is why the range is wide.
findings.independence: Q1 tanshin's 'no change, broadly as planned' statement: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260708/140120260708589428.pdf. Consensus 69,561m: https://kabuyoho.jp/reportNews?bcode=2670.

findings.finding: The stock ran +4.4% in the two sessions after the September 月次 (10-02 close 2,666.5 to 2,794.5 spot) on a 7.52x margin-long register, into a print type it has sold 9 of the last 12 times (actual next-day moves on the 12 release dates: -7.22, +1.97, +4.26, -5.06, +0.10, -4.09, -3.99, -2.50, -8.81, -6.38, +7.66, -11.37). The Q1 fall came after a +5.3% two-session run-in.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 prints: 2023-10 -7.22, 2024-10 +0.10, 2025-10 -8.81. The last four prints had a median absolute move of about 8.3%.
findings.why_not_priced: Reaction history is not information about this print, which is why this is sized small. If the run-in were being faded already, the stock would have given back the 10-06 gain this morning, and at 10:05 it is +0.2%.
findings.independence: Margin ratio from kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2670&b=n202610060736) and the release dates from kabutan's finance table (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=2670). The price series is one source.

findings.finding: September domestic comps were +14.9% (customers +10.4%, ticket +4.1%), the first double-digit month since December 2024, with one extra holiday. That gives management a strong H2 opening to cite in the release and limits how negatively a held FY plan reads.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock rose 1.63% on 10-05 and 2.80% on 10-06 when this was published. The FY guide print in April 2026 rose 7.66% when the outlook was positive.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stock already rose 4.4% on it. What is left is whether the release turns it into firmer guidance language or a raise.

findings.finding: The 2026-07-28 Kumamoto earthquake closed 15 stores. Two (ABC-MART イオンモール宇城 and ABC-MART SPORTS イオンモール熊本) have closed permanently and one remains shut, so a small 災害損失 or closure loss below operating income is likely in H1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None on record for this line.
findings.why_not_priced: Immaterial at about 3 of roughly 1,118 stores, and the loss sits below operating income with no path to the guide, so it is sized near zero.
findings.independence: The July 月次 notes 15 stores closed: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260804/140120260804507966.pdf

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: none pre-filed; a hold is likely and consensus is about 3% above the FY plan. Returns: interim dividend 40 yen already planned (up from 35), no buyback habit. New-year guide: not applicable at H1. Quarter: Q1 ordinary progress against the H1 plan was 59.0%, versus 53.1% (2025) and 54.6% (2024) at the same point, so H1 likely lands at plan, with Q2 OP down YoY on domestic +2.1%.
baseline_tension: This agrees with the baseline lean (-0.56, mostly margin overhang) and cuts against the +4.4% two-day run. The strongest positive the release could carry is a firmed or raised FY outlook on the back of September's +14.9% comps. I looked for a buyback or a dividend change and found no habit of either at H1. A raise would flip this name, as the April +7.66% did.
lessons_applied: Rule 1: the Q2 finding rests partly on public 月次. It went from -1.0 to -0.6, keeping only the unseen gross-margin and inventory part, and p_up moved from 40 to 42.
Open question 4 (a run-in into a print was once wrong as a short signal): the positioning finding went from -1.0 to -0.7.
Rule 2: wrote the strongest positive (FY raise on September comps) into baseline_tension. I had looked for buybacks and dividend changes, so this rule moved no number.
Unchanged: the guidance-hold finding (-0.4), the September-comps positive (+0.5), the earthquake one-off (-0.1) and abs_move_pct 5.5.
